chapters.title: Off to Camp
chapters.completeText: The tent is up and the lake is shining. First stop tomorrow: the little camp shop!

tasks.prompt: Our summer trip starts today, and Dad calls from the front door. Read what he is pointing at.
tasks.success: The red car is packed to the roof - off we go!

tasks.prompt: On the way we pass a wide green field. Read who is standing by the fence.
tasks.success: Two cows look up and chew slowly as we go by.

tasks.prompt: Halfway there, we stop for a snack and stay in our seats. Read who is up front and what is going on.
tasks.success: Dad sings the camp song, and we all join in!

tasks.prompt: At the camp gate, somebody comes out to meet us. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small dog wags its tail - this is Pip, the camp dog.

tasks.prompt: Ollie the otter, our camp guide, points up at the old oak tree. Read who is up there.
tasks.success: One owl blinks at us from a hole in the trunk.

tasks.prompt: The family in the next tent waves hello. Read what they came with.
tasks.success: A blue car full of beach toys - they came for the lake too!

tasks.prompt: Somebody is already out by the lake. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Mom walks along the shore to find the best spot.

tasks.prompt: Ollie points at the water by the reeds. Read who is there.
tasks.success: Ten ducks paddle by in a long line, like a little parade.

tasks.prompt: Ollie shows us what we can use at camp. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A big boat - room for the whole family!

tasks.prompt: In the tent next door, somebody is cuddling a teddy. Read who is inside and what is happening.
tasks.success: A boy sings to his teddy very softly, and then the lamp goes out.

chapters.title: The Camp Shop
chapters.completeText: Our bags are full of shop treasures. Tomorrow we visit Farmer Rosa's farm next door!

tasks.prompt: Ollie opens the door of the little camp shop. Read what is on the first shelf.
tasks.success: A blue book of camp songs - we will need that!

tasks.prompt: The shop sells fresh food from the farm. Read what is in the basket by the till.
tasks.success: Six eggs, still warm from Farmer Rosa's hens.

tasks.prompt: Every tent at camp gets something to hang by its door. Read what Ollie gives us.
tasks.success: A red flag for our tent - now everyone can find us!

tasks.prompt: Ollie climbs a ladder to reach the top shelf. Read what he brings down.
tasks.success: A big ball for games on the beach.

tasks.prompt: Behind the counter there is a soft basket. Read who is in it and what is going on.
tasks.success: The shop cat sings a little meow-song whenever someone comes in!

tasks.prompt: Toys of all kinds hang from the ceiling. Read what Ollie points at.
tasks.success: Two kites, one for each of us!

tasks.prompt: At the till there is a jar of stickers. Read which sticker we pick.
tasks.success: A red heart sticker for Mom's water bottle.

tasks.prompt: Outside the shop, somebody is busy on the grass. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Dad plays a game with the other dads and wins!

tasks.prompt: The shop is taking orders for the camp party. Read what the poster shows.
tasks.success: A big cake for the goodbye party on our last day!

tasks.prompt: On the way back, Ollie kneels down by the path. Read who is down there.
tasks.success: Ten ants carry crumbs from the shop back home.

chapters.title: Farmer Rosa's Farm
chapters.completeText: We said goodbye to every animal on the farm. Tomorrow Miss Lark opens the art tent!

tasks.prompt: Farmer Rosa opens the barn door wide. Read who is first in line and what is going on.
tasks.success: The pig sings an oink-oink song to say good morning!

tasks.prompt: Next, Rosa scatters grain on the ground. Read who comes over.
tasks.success: Four hens peck at the grain, cluck-cluck.

tasks.prompt: In the corner of the pen there is a pile of straw. Read who is hiding in it.
tasks.success: A small pig peeks out with a pink nose.

tasks.prompt: Rosa hands us a basket to carry. Read what is inside.
tasks.success: Nine eggs - we must walk very carefully!

tasks.prompt: Rosa says she keeps something special by the gate. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A red car - Rosa drives it to the market on Saturdays.

tasks.prompt: In the next stall, Rosa lifts her lamp. Read who is there and what is happening.
tasks.success: The cow sings moo-moo, and the whole barn echoes.

tasks.prompt: Out in the field, somebody is eating grass by the fence. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A big cow - her name is Daisy, and she is the boss of the field.

tasks.prompt: By the pond, Rosa whistles loudly. Read who hurries over.
tasks.success: Two sheep come over, fluffy as clouds.

tasks.prompt: Somebody sets off down the farm road to fetch the milk. Read who it is and how.
tasks.success: Dad rides Rosa's old bike down the farm road.

tasks.prompt: Somebody is sitting on the fence post and watching us. Who is it? Read.
tasks.success: A small hen - she is the youngest on the farm.

chapters.title: The Art Tent
chapters.completeText: Our paintings are drying on a string. Tomorrow we head down to the lake!

tasks.prompt: Miss Lark the parrot dips her brush in a jar and touches the paper. Read what she painted.
tasks.success: A green dot - the start of a whole picture.

tasks.prompt: Miss Lark paints again, right next to it. Read what is there now.
tasks.success: A blue dot, like a little pond.

tasks.prompt: Miss Lark pins a picture up on the wall. Read who is on it.
tasks.success: Five pigs in a row - she painted Rosa's farm!

tasks.prompt: On the next easel, a picture is drying. Read what it shows.
tasks.success: A big fish - it fills the whole page!

tasks.prompt: Under the paint table there is a little rug. Read who is on it and what is going on.
tasks.success: Pip the dog sings along to Miss Lark's whistle.

tasks.prompt: Miss Lark gives us a brush of our own. Read what we painted.
tasks.success: A black dot - it looks like a spot on a ladybug.

tasks.prompt: Miss Lark shows us a drawing from last summer. Read who is in it.
tasks.success: A small owl on a branch, with round eyes.

tasks.prompt: Miss Lark peels the cover off a sticker sheet. Read what appears.
tasks.success: Ten stars sparkle like a night sky!

tasks.prompt: In the corner, somebody sits on a beanbag. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: Mom sings a soft song on the beanbag.

tasks.prompt: To finish, Miss Lark lets everyone paint one last thing. Read what we made.
tasks.success: A red heart for Mom and Dad!

chapters.title: Down at the Lake
chapters.completeText: We are wet, sandy and happy. Tomorrow Farmer Rosa takes us to her apple orchard!

tasks.prompt: The lake is calm this morning, and somebody is already down at the water. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Mom swims all the way out to the yellow buoy!

tasks.prompt: Ollie points to the middle of the lake. Read who is out there.
tasks.success: Dad rows our boat in slow circles.

tasks.prompt: We look down from the dock into the clear water. Read who is down there.
tasks.success: Two fish flick their tails and dart away.

tasks.prompt: Somebody is paddling near the reeds. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A big duck with a shiny green head.

tasks.prompt: Along the shore, Ollie lifts a lily pad. Read who is under it.
tasks.success: Two frogs blink and hop away - plop, plop!

tasks.prompt: Something splashes in the reeds. What is it? Read.
tasks.success: A big frog - as big as Dad's hand!

tasks.prompt: Ollie points at the lifeguard tower. Read what is up there.
tasks.success: A red flag flies on top of the tower.

tasks.prompt: On the far shore, somebody sits on a rock. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: A fox sings to the sunset - what a funny sound!

tasks.prompt: A noisy group flies low over the water and lands. Read who they are.
tasks.success: Six geese land on the lake with a big splash.

tasks.prompt: Something is hiding under a rock on the beach. Read what Ollie finds.
tasks.success: A big crab waves its claws at us!

chapters.title: The Apple Orchard
chapters.completeText: Our baskets are heavy and our hands are sticky. Tomorrow Ollie leads a walk in the forest!

tasks.prompt: Farmer Rosa lifts us up to the lowest branch. Read what we pick.
tasks.success: A red apple, shiny and sweet!

tasks.prompt: On the far side of the orchard, somebody is busy. Read who is there.
tasks.success: Five bees buzz from flower to flower.

tasks.prompt: Rosa reaches into a different tree. Read what she picks for us.
tasks.success: A big pear - we will share it.

tasks.prompt: Something tickles my arm. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A small ant - we put it back on the grass.

tasks.prompt: Somebody carries the full basket back to the farmhouse. Read who it is and how.
tasks.success: Dad walks slowly with the heavy basket.

tasks.prompt: We sort the fruit on Rosa's table. Read what is in the first bowl.
tasks.success: Six pears, green and juicy.

tasks.prompt: A gust of wind blows through the orchard. Read what lands on my hat.
tasks.success: A red leaf, like a little maple star.

tasks.prompt: High up in the oldest tree, somebody is sitting. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: The owl sings hoo-hoo, right in the middle of the day!

tasks.prompt: Something pulls Rosa's fruit cart up the hill. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A big horse named Thunder pulls the cart.

tasks.prompt: Under the trees, somebody is munching the fallen fruit. Who is it? Read.
tasks.success: Two pigs crunch the fallen apples, very happy.

chapters.title: The Forest Walk
chapters.completeText: We found the way home by the light of the moon. Tomorrow the camp kitchen needs helpers!

tasks.prompt: Ollie leads us into the woods. Behind a fallen tree, somebody is peeking at us. Read who it is.
tasks.success: One fox peeks out, then vanishes.

tasks.prompt: Ollie asks everyone to find something for the nature table. Read what I found.
tasks.success: A red leaf, as bright as a little fire.

tasks.prompt: Ollie spots tracks in the mud. Read who made them.
tasks.success: A big bear - far, far away, munching berries.

tasks.prompt: On an old stump, there is a busy little crowd. Read who they are.
tasks.success: Nine ants march in a line over the stump.

tasks.prompt: Somebody leads the group along the narrow trail. Read who it is and how.
tasks.success: Mom walks first and checks the map.

tasks.prompt: Something rustles under a bush. Read who is there.
tasks.success: A small fox cub, curious and quiet.

tasks.prompt: Ollie shows us the marks painted on the trees along the trail. Read the first one.
tasks.success: A white dot on every tree shows the way home.

tasks.prompt: Further on, the trail splits in two. Read the mark on the left path.
tasks.success: A red dot - this path goes to the waterfall.

tasks.prompt: As it gets dark, Ollie shines a torch at an old hollow tree. Read who looks back at us.
tasks.success: Two owls blink in the torchlight.

tasks.prompt: Back at the tent, somebody is lying in the hammock. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: Dad sings to the stars from his hammock.

chapters.title: The Camp Kitchen
chapters.completeText: Dinner was a feast, and the pots are clean. Tomorrow is Sports Day!

tasks.prompt: Chef Basil has a visitor this morning. Read who is there and what they are up to.
tasks.success: Mom cooks pancakes for the whole camp!

tasks.prompt: Chef Basil opens the tall fridge. Read what he takes out.
tasks.success: Ten eggs for ten pancakes!

tasks.prompt: Chef Basil holds up something funny from the box. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A big egg - a goose from the farm laid it!

tasks.prompt: Chef Basil opens the pantry door. Read what is waiting inside.
tasks.success: Two cakes, with candles on top already!

tasks.prompt: Out on the deck, somebody is busy. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Dad cooks the corn, and it smells great!

tasks.prompt: Chef Basil hides something on the top shelf. Read what is up there.
tasks.success: A big cake for the party - shh, it is a surprise!

tasks.prompt: Chef Basil reaches into the cupboard. Read what he takes off the shelf.
tasks.success: A red book of recipes, covered in flour.

tasks.prompt: On the warm windowsill, somebody is lying in the sun. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: The kitchen cat sings for a bit of fish.

tasks.prompt: Somebody brings a crate to the kitchen door. Read what is in it.
tasks.success: Six fish for dinner tonight!

tasks.prompt: Chef Basil needs something for the drinks. Read what he cuts in half.
tasks.success: A big lemon - enough for the whole jug!

chapters.title: Sports Day
chapters.completeText: Everybody got a medal, even Pip. Tomorrow we ride the bike trail!

tasks.prompt: Ollie gives every team a sticker. Read what is on ours.
tasks.success: A blue dot - we are the blue team!

tasks.prompt: The first race starts at the whistle. Read who is in front and what is going on.
tasks.success: Mom runs past everyone and wins!

tasks.prompt: In the next race, somebody is way ahead. Read who it is and how.
tasks.success: Dad runs and runs - and trips over Pip, oops!

tasks.prompt: Ollie empties the sports bag onto the grass. Read what falls out.
tasks.success: Six balls - enough for every game today!

tasks.prompt: For the last game, Ollie brings something out of the shed. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A big ball - it takes two of us to push it!

tasks.prompt: On the court, somebody shows the kids a trick. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Dad plays and scores a basket!

tasks.prompt: In the funny pet race, the winners cross the finish line side by side. Read who they are.
tasks.success: Two dogs cross the line together - it is a tie!

tasks.prompt: Ollie hangs the last medal around somebody's neck. Read who gets it.
tasks.success: A small dog - Pip wins a medal too!

tasks.prompt: Every runner gets a badge at the end. Read what is on mine.
tasks.success: A red heart badge, for trying your best!

tasks.prompt: Over the fence, Rosa's animals are watching the races. Read who is there.
tasks.success: Ten sheep stand in a row and say baa for the winners!

chapters.title: The Bike Trail
chapters.completeText: Our legs are tired and our faces are muddy. Tomorrow it rains - time for games in the dining hall!

tasks.prompt: Ollie blows his whistle at the start of the trail. Read who sets off first and how.
tasks.success: Mom rides ahead and rings her bell - ring, ring!

tasks.prompt: At the steep hill, somebody is falling behind. Read who it is and how they go.
tasks.success: Dad walks up the hill and pushes his bike.

tasks.prompt: The trail passes Rosa's back field. Read who is lying in the grass.
tasks.success: Six cows rest in the shade and watch us go by.

tasks.prompt: We stop at a puddle in the middle of the trail. Read what is crossing it.
tasks.success: A big snail - we wait for it to cross!

tasks.prompt: At the fork in the trail, Ollie points at the sign. Read the mark on it.
tasks.success: A green dot - the easy way back to camp.

tasks.prompt: Down by the creek, somebody is waddling along. Who is it? Read.
tasks.success: Two ducks waddle to the water, quack-quack.

tasks.prompt: Something is sitting on my handlebar. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A small bee - and off it buzzes again.

tasks.prompt: At the end of the trail, Ollie points at something by the gate. Read what is waiting there.
tasks.success: A blue car - our tent neighbors have room for our bikes!

tasks.prompt: Behind Ollie's bike, somebody rides along in a trailer. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: Pip sings the whole way home - woof-woof-la!

tasks.prompt: On the ride home, we look up at the sky. Read what is above us.
tasks.success: Six stars come out, one by one.

chapters.title: A Rainy Day
chapters.completeText: The rain has stopped, and there is a rainbow over the lake. Tomorrow is the pet show!

tasks.prompt: Rain drums on the roof of the dining hall, so Miss Lark spins the arrow on a game board. Read where it stops.
tasks.success: A brown dot - everybody puts a hand on it!

tasks.prompt: Something is hiding under the stage. Read who it is.
tasks.success: Two mice nibble a cookie crumb.

tasks.prompt: Miss Lark spins the arrow again. Read what it lands on this time.
tasks.success: A black dot - now my foot goes there, wobble, wobble!

tasks.prompt: Ollie pulls something out of the toy chest. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A big drum - boom, boom, louder than the rain!

tasks.prompt: In the middle of the hall, somebody is busy with the kids. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Mom plays a ball game with us, nice and gently.

tasks.prompt: Miss Lark opens the reading corner. Read what I take from the box.
tasks.success: A blue book about whales - my favorite!

tasks.prompt: Ollie sets up the toy farm on the floor. Read who he puts by the barn.
tasks.success: A small cow - just like Daisy, only tiny.

tasks.prompt: We finish a jigsaw puzzle together. Read what is in the picture.
tasks.success: Ten fish in a big blue sea!

tasks.prompt: Ollie turns the toy farm around. Read who is in the barn and what is going on.
tasks.success: The cow sings moo-la-la in Ollie's funny voice.

tasks.prompt: From the window we can see the rest of the camp in the rain. Read what is down by the trees.
tasks.success: Two tents, wet but cozy.

chapters.title: The Pet Show
chapters.completeText: Every pet got a ribbon, and Pip got two. Tomorrow we explore the frog pond!

tasks.prompt: The first pet steps onto the stage. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A big dog - it sits so nicely for the judges.

tasks.prompt: Next, a girl comes up to the judges with her pet. Read who she brings.
tasks.success: A small cat with soft fur, purring.

tasks.prompt: A basket is set on the judges' table. Read who peeks out of it.
tasks.success: Four cats in one basket - what a sight!

tasks.prompt: Farmer Rosa brings her own pet to the stage. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: Rosa's pig sings, and the judges clap!

tasks.prompt: The next pet sits on a velvet pillow. What is it? Read.
tasks.success: A big cat - the biggest one at camp!

tasks.prompt: The judge sits at a table by the stage. Read what she has in front of her.
tasks.success: A red book full of scores and little stars.

tasks.prompt: A boy shows off his pets in a glass box. Read who is inside.
tasks.success: Ten mice run around a little wheel.

tasks.prompt: The pet show is nearly over, and the curtain opens one last time. Read who it is and what happens.
tasks.success: A boy sings a song about his hamster!

tasks.prompt: Each pet gets a ribbon with a sticker. Read what is on Pip's.
tasks.success: A brown dot - Pip's favorite color!

tasks.prompt: Rosa holds up the winner of the cutest pet prize. Read who won.
tasks.success: A small pig - it squeals with joy!

chapters.title: The Frog Pond
chapters.completeText: The frogs croaked us goodnight. Tomorrow is the big boat race!

tasks.prompt: Ollie lifts his net out of the pond. Read who is in it.
tasks.success: Ten frogs hop out of the net, one after another!

tasks.prompt: Somebody glides across the pond, very proud. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A big swan, white as snow.

tasks.prompt: On a branch over the water, somebody is sitting. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: An owl sings to the frogs - hoo-hoo, ribbit!

tasks.prompt: In the reeds, Ollie finds a nest. Read what is in it.
tasks.success: A small egg - a duckling will hatch soon!

tasks.prompt: We have a picnic by the pond. Read what Ollie gives me.
tasks.success: A red apple from Rosa's orchard.

tasks.prompt: A group comes splashing across the water. Read who they are.
tasks.success: Two geese splash and flap their wings.

tasks.prompt: Somebody is out in the middle of the pond. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Dad swims with the frogs - ribbit!

tasks.prompt: The water lilies are open on the pond. Read who visits them.
tasks.success: Four bees visit the water lilies.

tasks.prompt: In the tall grass by the pond, somebody has a hiding place. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: A fox sings along with the frogs - what a choir!

tasks.prompt: Back at camp, Ollie marks the pond on our map. Read the mark he makes.
tasks.success: A white dot on the map - the frog pond!

chapters.title: The Boat Race
chapters.completeText: Our boat came in second, and we are still cheering. Tomorrow Ollie hides a treasure!

tasks.prompt: The race begins with a whistle. Read who is out in front and what is going on.
tasks.success: Mom rows hard and takes the lead!

tasks.prompt: On the shore, everyone is cheering for somebody. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Dad rows past the flag - go, Dad, go!

tasks.prompt: Ollie counts everyone at the start line. Read what lines up.
tasks.success: Six boats in a row, ready to race!

tasks.prompt: At the finish line, Ollie holds something up. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A red flag - the race is over!

tasks.prompt: Out on the water, something is moving fast. What is it? Read.
tasks.success: A big boat wins the race - what a splash!

tasks.prompt: Somebody sits at the front of our boat like a captain. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small dog - Pip is our captain!

tasks.prompt: Near the finish, somebody glides out of the reeds to watch. Read who they are.
tasks.success: Two swans watch the race like judges.

tasks.prompt: The winners write their names down. Read where they write them.
tasks.success: A blue book of winners - our names are in it now!

tasks.prompt: On the dock, somebody is watching the boats. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: The shop cat sings for the winners!

tasks.prompt: After the race, we peek into the water by the dock. Read who is there.
tasks.success: Five fish swim under our boat.

chapters.title: The Treasure Hunt
chapters.completeText: We found the treasure chest at last, with a gift for everyone. Tomorrow is the bake sale!

tasks.prompt: Ollie gives us a map. Read the mark on the first tree.
tasks.success: A red dot - the hunt starts here!

tasks.prompt: Under the first tree, Ollie digs a little hole. Read what we find.
tasks.success: One shell with a note inside: go to the lake!

tasks.prompt: By the lake, something is lying on the sand. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A big shell - hold it to your ear and hear the sea!

tasks.prompt: Somebody spots the next clue first. Read who it is and how they get there.
tasks.success: Mom runs to the old boathouse to get it!

tasks.prompt: Inside the boathouse, there is a shiny drawing on the wall. Read what it shows.
tasks.success: Two stars point to the forest path.

tasks.prompt: On the path, Ollie finds a painted stone. Read what is on it.
tasks.success: A black dot - the pirate's mark!

tasks.prompt: At Rosa's barn, somebody is keeping the next clue. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: The cow sings, and the clue falls out of the hay!

tasks.prompt: Behind the barn, something is waiting for us. Read what is there.
tasks.success: A big gift - but it is only the next clue!

tasks.prompt: At last, the treasure chest! Ollie opens the lid. Read what is inside.
tasks.success: Six gifts - one for every kid in our tent row!

tasks.prompt: Somebody watched us from the treasure tree the whole time. Read who it was.
tasks.success: A small owl - it knew where the treasure was!

chapters.title: The Bake Sale
chapters.completeText: Every cake is sold, and the money goes to the camp library. Tomorrow is the talent show!

tasks.prompt: Early in the morning, the kitchen lights are already on. Read who is in there and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Mom cooks a big pot of jam for the sale.

tasks.prompt: Chef Basil carries out a long tray. Read what is on it.
tasks.success: Ten cakes with candles - the bake sale can begin!

tasks.prompt: The prize for the raffle sits on the front table. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A big cake - and we win it!

tasks.prompt: Farmer Rosa brings a crate to sell. Read what is on top.
tasks.success: A red apple for every pie.

tasks.prompt: Somebody sits behind the money box. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: Dad sings 'Cakes for sale!' to everyone who walks by.

tasks.prompt: Chef Basil needs one more thing for the pie. Read what he picks.
tasks.success: A big lemon for a sour, sunny pie!

tasks.prompt: Outside, some pets are hoping for treats. Read who is waiting.
tasks.success: Six dogs sit and wait for a cookie each.

tasks.prompt: Ollie points at something new by the gate. Read what he sees.
tasks.success: A blue car - more customers are here!

tasks.prompt: Up on the roof of the bake sale tent, somebody is sitting. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: An owl sings hoo-hoo, and everyone looks up!

tasks.prompt: Rosa has one more thing from her farm to sell. Read what she has.
tasks.success: Five eggs, the last box of the day!

chapters.title: The Talent Show
chapters.completeText: Everybody took a bow, even the shy ones. Tomorrow night is the campfire!

tasks.prompt: The show begins, and somebody steps into the spotlight. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Mom plays ball like a star!

tasks.prompt: Next, the curtain opens on somebody shy. Read who it is and what happens.
tasks.success: A boy sings, and his voice gets braver and braver!

tasks.prompt: Miss Lark brings out her puppets. Read who she shows us.
tasks.success: Ten owls on ten sticks - a puppet choir!

tasks.prompt: Farmer Rosa's act has a helper. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small pig does a twirl!

tasks.prompt: After the break, somebody takes the stage. Read who is up there and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Dad plays and bounces the ball under his leg!

tasks.prompt: Somebody in a furry costume jumps out and roars. Read who it is meant to be.
tasks.success: A big lion - and it is Ollie under there!

tasks.prompt: The magician taps her wand, and something appears on the screen. Read what appears.
tasks.success: A green dot - and then poof, it is gone!

tasks.prompt: The magician lifts her hat. Read who is under it.
tasks.success: Six mice wave at the crowd!

tasks.prompt: Somebody is back on the stage for one more act. Read who it is and what is going on now.
tasks.success: Rosa's pig sings again, even louder!

tasks.prompt: At the end, Miss Lark gives a prize to every act. Read what she hands out.
tasks.success: A big star for every act - we all shine!

chapters.title: The Campfire
chapters.completeText: The fire is low and the marshmallows are gone. Tomorrow is our last day at camp.

tasks.prompt: Everyone sits around the fire. Read who sits closest to it and what is going on.
tasks.success: Pip sings a howly campfire song - aroooo!

tasks.prompt: We lie on our backs and look up. Read what we see.
tasks.success: Ten stars, and then more and more!

tasks.prompt: At the edge of the forest, somebody sits and looks at the fire. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: A fox sings to the fire, very quietly.

tasks.prompt: Something peeks out from behind a tree near the fire. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small fox - it wants a marshmallow too!

tasks.prompt: Somebody is busy on the far side of the fire. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Dad cooks marshmallows until they are golden.

tasks.prompt: Somebody wraps up in a blanket by the fire. Read what is going on, and who it is.
tasks.success: Mom sings a slow, sleepy song.

tasks.prompt: In the dark trees, eyes are shining. Read who is looking at us.
tasks.success: Two owls watch our campfire from above.

tasks.prompt: A gust of wind blows something into the firelight. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A red leaf floats in the warm air.

tasks.prompt: Something comes for the crumbs we dropped. Read what comes.
tasks.success: A big mouse with a fat belly - it ate too many crumbs!

tasks.prompt: When the fire goes out, Ollie points at the sky again. Read what he shows us.
tasks.success: One star, the brightest of all, to make a wish on.

chapters.title: The Last Swim
chapters.completeText: We packed the tent and said goodbye to the lake. Only the goodbye party is left!

tasks.prompt: It is our last morning by the lake. Read who is out first and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Mom swims one last time to the buoy and back.

tasks.prompt: Somebody heads back to the shop to return the things we borrowed. Read who it is and how.
tasks.success: Dad rides to the shop on the borrowed bike.

tasks.prompt: Ollie's rod bends and jerks. Read what he pulls up.
tasks.success: A big fish - and he lets it go again.

tasks.prompt: For the last time, a long line paddles past the dock. Read who they are.
tasks.success: Ten ducks - they came to say goodbye!

tasks.prompt: Dad calls us from the parking field. Read what he is standing next to.
tasks.success: The red car is packed again - it is almost time to go home.

tasks.prompt: On our way past the farm, somebody hurries to the fence. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small hen - cluck, cluck, goodbye!

tasks.prompt: Behind her, more friends come to the fence. Read who else comes.
tasks.success: Two cows moo goodbye.

tasks.prompt: Ollie gives us a goodbye card. Read what is drawn on it.
tasks.success: A blue dot - it is the lake, seen from the sky!

tasks.prompt: Somebody takes one last look along the shore. Read who it is and how they go.
tasks.success: Mom walks along the shore and picks up a shell.

tasks.prompt: At the edge of the forest, something is watching us leave. What is it? Read.
tasks.success: A big bear, far away. Bye, bear!

chapters.title: The Goodbye Party
chapters.completeText: Goodbye, Camp Willow! We will be back next summer - Pip, Ollie and the frogs will wait for us.

tasks.prompt: Miss Lark hands out party hats with stickers. Read what is on mine.
tasks.success: A brown dot - just like on Pip's ribbon!

tasks.prompt: Chef Basil rolls out a cart for the party. Read what is on it.
tasks.success: Six cakes - one for each table!

tasks.prompt: Somebody is busy behind the party table. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Dad cooks his famous corn one last time.

tasks.prompt: Ollie has a present for us. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A big kite to take home - with a long tail!

tasks.prompt: Every pet from the pet show comes to the party. Read who comes in.
tasks.success: Five dogs bark hello - Pip is the loudest!

tasks.prompt: Somebody sits in the comfy armchair by the stage. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: Mom sings our camp song, and everyone joins in.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Rosa arrives at the party gate. Read who is with her.
tasks.success: Four pigs oink a happy hello!

tasks.prompt: Ollie brings out something for everyone to sign. Read what he brings.
tasks.success: A red book of camp memories - we write our names in it!

tasks.prompt: Something is on our picnic blanket. Read what is there.
tasks.success: A small ant - it wants some cake crumbs!

tasks.prompt: At the gate, somebody waits to say the very last goodbye. Read who is waiting.
tasks.success: A big dog - Pip's best friend from the pet show!
